title: Register Custom Post Type
description: Creating a new post type for things like 'Movies' or 'Products'.
explanation_md: Registers a new 'movies' post type in the WordPress admin, enabling custom content structures beyond just Posts and Pages.

title: Enqueue Scripts and Styles
description: Properly adding CSS and JS files to your theme.
explanation_md: The standard way to load stylesheets and scripts in WordPress. Using `wp_enqueue` ensures dependencies (like jQuery) are handled correctly.

title: Create a Custom Shortcode
description: A reusable shortcode for displaying dynamic content.
explanation_md: Shortcodes allow users to insert dynamic content or complex UI elements into posts/pages using simple bracketed tags.

title: Custom REST API Endpoint
description: Registering a new route in the WordPress REST API.
explanation_md: Extends the WordPress REST API with a custom endpoint, useful for building headless WordPress sites or custom integrations.

title: Modify Main Query via Pre_get_posts
description: Changing the global query before it runs.
explanation_md: The `pre_get_posts` hook is the most efficient way to alter the main WordPress query (e.g., hiding certain posts or changing order) before the database is even queried.
